flags.name: dry-run
flags.description: Report what would happen, and change nothing

flags.name: force
flags.description: Allow this explicit raw mutation (not required for previews or known read endpoints)

flags.name: if-match
flags.description: Send If-Match with a quoted entity tag, list of tags, or *

flags.name: if-unmodified-since
flags.description: Send If-Unmodified-Since with an HTTP date in GMT

flags.name: input
flags.description: Send exact body bytes from FILE or - for piped stdin (1 MiB limit)

flags.name: max-response-bytes
flags.description: Maximum captured response bytes; 0 explicitly removes the bound

flags.name: query
flags.description: Add a literal query name=value (repeatable; commas are preserved)

extensions.examples:
$ jira api post /rest/api/3/search/jql --input search.json --output=json

# preview an explicit mutation before sending it with --force
$ jira api post /rest/api/3/issue --input issue.json --dry-run --output=json
extensions.long:
Send a request to /rest/api/... or /rest/agile/... on the configured site. Absolute URLs, encoded path segments and embedded query strings are refused. Use repeated --query name=value flags for query parameters.

--input FILE (or - for piped standard input) sends exact bytes, up to 1 MiB. JSON is the default content type; use --content-type for other bodies. Raw bodies are not converted or checked against a domain schema.

GET, HEAD and OPTIONS are reads. POST to /rest/api/3/search/jql, /rest/api/3/search/approximate-count, or /rest/api/3/jql/parse is also a read. All other POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE requests require --force, even at a terminal. --dry-run prepares the request locally without authentication or network access. Read-only configuration still refuses writes with --force. Writes are never automatically replayed.

--if-match sends a quoted entity tag, a list of tags, or *. --if-unmodified-since sends an HTTP date in GMT. If-Match takes precedence when both are supplied. These are HTTP preconditions; protection depends on the endpoint enforcing them.

The response includes HTTP status, allowed headers, exact body_base64 bytes, and optional UTF-8 body_text and complete JSON views. The default capture bound is 16 MiB; --max-response-bytes=0 explicitly removes it. HTTP failures and incomplete captures retain the receipt in a full failure frame, even in compact mode. Inspect mutation outcomes before retrying; no raw fallback runs implicitly.

output_schema.description: An explicit platform or Agile API request and its inspectable HTTP receipt. A receipt does not establish whether a failed mutation took effect.

json.description: Present only for a complete valid JSON body. Exact bytes remain in body_base64.
